job_description:
Software Engineer - WCS/WES Systems 💰 Salary: $75,000 - 150,000 per year

At Conveyor Handling Company we are looking for a System engineer!

🛠️ Our tech stack:
AI, AWS, Azure, C#, Cloud, Flow, Support, Java, MQTT, Network, PLC, Python, REST, Robotics, SAP, SAP EWM, SQL, Security, TCP/IP, System

📝 Rquirements:
- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline
- Over 5 years of experience in warehouse automation or material handling systems
- Proven experience in developing or supporting Warehouse Control Systems (WCS)
- Familiarity with interfacing with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
- Strong comprehension of conveyor systems, sortation systems, robotics, and goods-to-person automation
- Proficient in industrial communication protocols and automation interfaces
- Expertise in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, SQL
- Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server or similar relational databases
- Capability to troubleshoot real-time operational systems in active distribution settings
- Excellent communication and project management skills
- Willingness to travel for system startup and customer support as needed (Travel 10-30%)
- Profound understanding of network architecture and industrial communications, with the ability to troubleshoot sub-second round-trip performance in real-time systems
- Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles, with a commitment to obtaining relevant certifications (CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent)
- Awareness of cloud technologies or relevant cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent)

👩‍💻👨‍💻 Your responsibilities are:
- Design, develop, test, and implement Warehouse Control System (WCS) and Warehouse Execution System (WES) software solutions
- Create and sustain interfaces between WCS and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) like Manhattan, Korber, SAP EWM
- Integrate conveyor controls, robotic systems, ASRS systems, AMRs, sortation systems, and goods-to-person technologies
- Develop communication interfaces with PLCs, scanners, printers, and automation equipment
- Support real-time controls and material flow logic for high-throughput distribution operations
- Engage in system architecture, software design, and database development
- Diagnose software, controls, and operational issues during testing, startup, and live production
- Assist in commissioning and go-live activities at customer sites
- Collaborate with controls engineers, project managers, and operations teams during project execution
- Aid in software documentation, testing procedures, and customer training
- Provide post-installation support and optimize system performance

Benefits & perks that we offer:

Conveyor Handling Company - More about us and the role:
We are Conveyor Handling Company, Inc. (CHC), a premier material handling systems integrator focused on conveyor systems, warehouse automation, controls integration, and turnkey solutions. Situated in Elkridge, MD, we serve diverse industries, creating high-performance automated systems tailored for manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution needs. We offer competitive salaries, benefits, and the opportunity to work on substantial warehouse automation projects in a collaborative and innovative environment. We believe in fostering career growth within the rapidly evolving automation sector and may provide hybrid or remote work options for qualified candidates.
